label: Ex5 – Catch basins as storage reactors
desc: Ex3 with J1–J3 as storage units with 2-ft sumps + settling.
inp:
[TITLE]
;;Project Title/Notes
Exercise 5 - Exercise 3 with J1-J3 converted to storage nodes (2 ft sumps) + first-order settling

[OPTIONS]
FLOW_UNITS           CFS
INFILTRATION         HORTON
FLOW_ROUTING         DYNWAVE
LINK_OFFSETS         DEPTH
MIN_SLOPE            0
ALLOW_PONDING        NO
START_DATE           01/01/2026
START_TIME           00:00:00
REPORT_START_DATE    01/01/2026
REPORT_START_TIME    00:00:00
END_DATE             01/01/2026
END_TIME             23:59:00
DRY_DAYS             7
REPORT_STEP          00:01:00
WET_STEP             00:01:00
DRY_STEP             00:05:00
ROUTING_STEP         0:00:05
VARIABLE_STEP        0.75

[RAINGAGES]
;;Name  Format  Interval  SCF  Source
RG1  INTENSITY  0:10  1.0  TIMESERIES  Storm

[SUBCATCHMENTS]
;;Name  RainGage  Outlet  Area(ac)  %Imperv  Width(ft)  %Slope  CurbLen
S1  RG1  J1  4  60  400  1.5  0
S2  RG1  J2  4  60  400  1.5  0
S3  RG1  J3  4  60  400  1.5  0

[SUBAREAS]
;;Subcatch  N-Imperv  N-Perv  S-Imperv  S-Perv  PctZero  RouteTo
S1  0.012  0.15  0.05  0.10  25  OUTLET
S2  0.012  0.15  0.05  0.10  25  OUTLET
S3  0.012  0.15  0.05  0.10  25  OUTLET

[INFILTRATION]
;;Subcatch  MaxRate  MinRate  Decay  DryTime  MaxInfil
S1  3.0  0.5  4  7  0
S2  3.0  0.5  4  7  0
S3  3.0  0.5  4  7  0


[OUTFALLS]
;;Name  Elevation  Type  StageData  Gated
OUT1  94  FREE  NO

[STORAGE]
;;Name  InvertElev  MaxDepth  InitDepth  Shape  Coeff  Expon  Const  SurDepth  Fevap
;catch basin with 2 ft sump: floor 98.0 ft = pipe invert 100.0 - 2
J1  98.0  8.0  2.0  FUNCTIONAL  0  0  16  0  0
;catch basin with 2 ft sump: floor 96.0 ft = pipe invert 98.0 - 2
J2  96.0  8.0  2.0  FUNCTIONAL  0  0  16  0  0
;catch basin with 2 ft sump: floor 94.0 ft = pipe invert 96.0 - 2
J3  94.0  8.0  2.0  FUNCTIONAL  0  0  16  0  0

[CONDUITS]
;;Name  FromNode  ToNode  Length(ft)  Roughness  InOffset(ft)  OutOffset(ft)  InitFlow  MaxFlow
C1  J1  J2    400  0.013  2.0  2.0  0  0
C2  J2  J3    400  0.013  2.0  2.0  0  0
C3  J3  OUT1  400  0.013  2.0  0     0  0

[XSECTIONS]
;;Link  Shape  Geom1(ft)  Geom2  Geom3  Geom4  Barrels
C1  CIRCULAR  1.5  0  0  0  1
C2  CIRCULAR  2.0  0  0  0  1
C3  CIRCULAR  2.5  0  0  0  1

[POLLUTANTS]
;;Name  Units  Crain  Cgw  Crdii  Kdecay  SnowOnly  CoPollut  CoFrac  Cdwf  Cinit
TSS  MG/L  0  0  0  0  NO  *  0  0  0

[LANDUSES]
;;Name  SweepInterval  Availability  LastSwept
Residential  0  0  0

[COVERAGES]
;;Subcatch  LandUse  Percent
S1  Residential  100
S2  Residential  100
S3  Residential  100

[BUILDUP]
;;LandUse  Pollutant  Function  Max(lb/ac)  Rate(1/day)  Coeff3  PerUnit
Residential  TSS  EXP  50  0.5  0  AREA

[WASHOFF]
;;LandUse  Pollutant  Function  Coeff  Expon  SweepRmvl  BmpRmvl
Residential  TSS  EXP  1.0  1.5  0  0

[TREATMENT]
;;Node  Pollutant  Function
J1  TSS  C = TSS * EXP(-0.5*DT/3600)
J2  TSS  C = TSS * EXP(-0.5*DT/3600)
J3  TSS  C = TSS * EXP(-0.5*DT/3600)

[TIMESERIES]
;;Name  Time(h:mm)  Value(in/hr)
Storm  0:00  0.3
Storm  0:10  0.6
Storm  0:20  1.2
Storm  0:30  2.4
Storm  0:40  1.2
Storm  0:50  0.9
Storm  1:00  0.6
Storm  1:10  0.5
Storm  1:20  0.4
Storm  1:30  0.3
Storm  1:40  0.2
Storm  1:50  0.1
Storm  2:00  0

[REPORT]
SUBCATCHMENTS ALL
NODES ALL
LINKS ALL

[PROFILES]
;;Name  Links
"Main line"  C1 C2 C3

[MAP]
DIMENSIONS -100 -300 1700 700
Units Feet

[COORDINATES]
J1  100  200
J2  500  200
J3  900  200
OUT1  1300  200

[Polygons]
S1  0  300
S1  400  300
S1  400  600
S1  0  600
S2  400  300
S2  800  300
S2  800  600
S2  400  600
S3  800  300
S3  1200  300
S3  1200  600
S3  800  600

[SYMBOLS]
RG1  600  660
